tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are helping plan a surprise farewell party for a colleague who is leaving the university. You need to make arrangements for the celebration and want to contact the university's event coordinator, Ms. Lee. Write an email to Ms. Lee.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the event.
Describe the type of venue and decoration options you are looking for.
Request a meeting to finalize the arrangements.
tasks.subject: Farewell Party Planning
